balderton-hiya:ashbyhq:5b5f69c4-f0cf-451.description: ABOUT US At Hiya, we're making calls safe, useful, and human again. Voice is the most human form of communication, yet it's become one of the least trusted. Spam, scams, and AI manipulation have eroded what was once a simple way to connect. Hiya is changing that. Each month our AI voice technology analyzes 28+ billion calls, protecting over 550 million users and 800+ businesses worldwide. Hiya is growing 40%+ year over year, expanding globally, and defining what voice becomes next. Join us. You won't just work on what voice is today, you'll shape what it becomes tomorrow: smarter, safer, and genuinely worth answering again. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens. At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising. OpenX is seeking a Staff Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. Our exchange processes hundreds of billions of ad requests daily and generates petabytes of data, requiring advanced machine learning, deep learning, and modern AI techniques delivered through scalable platforms to create value for customers. A Staff Data Scientist is a senior technical leader whose impact spans multiple teams and business domains. In this role, you will solve complex marketplace problems, set technical direction for your domain, architect major ML systems, mentor other scientists, and partner with engineering and product leaders on data-driven strategy. Problems at this level include auction and marketplace optimization, bidding and yield strategy, relevance and prediction systems at exchange scale, causal measurement of marketplace changes, and capabilities for training, validating, and monitoring ML systems in production. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in applied machine learning, strong judgment in selecting methods for business problems at scale, and a track record of translating business needs into high-impact data science solutions.

Serve as a go-to expert in deep learning and related advanced data science domains, with the breadth to guide method selection across adjacent areas
Lead the evaluation and adoption of new AI/ML modeling techniques, frameworks, and research advancements relevant to OpenX’s marketplace problems
Define and evolve technical standards and best practices within their domain, influencing broader adoption across the organization

Identify and lead high-impact, cross-team data science initiatives, such as improving bidding strategies, building new prediction systems, or redesigning experimentation frameworks
In partnership with engineering and product leadership, drive the data science roadmap for a product area or platform capability
Partner with product managers and commercial stakeholders to translate marketplace problems into data science solutions with measurable business outcomes
Solve novel, ambiguous problems requiring innovation in methodology, algorithms, or feature engineering
Mentorship & Influence:
Mentor and develop senior data scientists, helping them grow toward broader technical leadership
Raise the skills, impact, and scientific rigor of teams around them through guidance, architectural patterns, and strategic direction
Communicate technical strategy and build consensus for complex decisions across senior leadership and cross-functional teams
qualifications: Ph.D. in Data Science, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or related technical field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience; OR M.S./B.S. with 8+ years of relevant experience and a demonstrated track record of leading cross-team technical strategy and delivering organization-level impact

Deep expertise in deep learning and broad fluency across the modern ML toolkit, with strong familiarity with optimization methods; additional experience in areas such as causal inference or experimentation design is a plus
Proven ability to architect and deliver complex, production-grade ML systems that operate at scale

Strong Python and SQL skills; experience with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

Track record of cross-team technical leadership and mentorship of senior data scientists and technical partners

yc-verifiable:lever:76aa8efa-7174-4776-b.description: About Us: Verifiable is a provider credentialing and network monitoring platform, delivery industry-leading AI, API and Software solutions to help healthcare organizations optimize operations at enterprise scale. We are a top Salesforce partner, winning the 2024 Salesforce Partner Innovation Award, and also were named to Inc. 5000 2025, the most prestigious ranking of America's fastest-growing private companies. We work with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others. Verifiable is a fast-moving, early-stage team that values impact, ownership, and follow-through. Everyone here rolls up their sleeves, dives into ambiguity, and takes end-to-end responsibility for meaningful work. Priorities shift, problems aren’t always perfectly defined, and we move with urgency—so we look for people who are energized by hard problems, rapid learning, and stepping in wherever the team needs support. We’re collaborative and human, but we keep a high bar. If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here. The Salesforce Implementation Consultant configures, customizes, and validates Verifiable’s Salesforce-based implementation solutions for customers. This role collaborates closely with Implementation Managers, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and customer stakeholders to deliver technically sound, scalable implementations aligned with customer business needs. The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly in Salesforce, translating customer requirements into technical solutions, and identifying risks early. Strong Salesforce configuration experience, problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences are essential.
responsibilities: Configure Verifiable’s Salesforce-based SaaS solutions for customer implementations, including fields, page layouts, permissions, automation, reporting, dashboards, and implementation-specific configuration.
Partner with Implementation Managers to translate customer requirements into clear technical solutions, implementation tasks, and delivery plans.
Serve as a trusted technical resource for customers and internal teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Build, update, and troubleshoot Salesforce automation, including Flow-based processes, validation rules, data updates, and configuration-driven business logic.
Support data migration, data cleanup, and backfill activities using Salesforce tools such as Data Loader, reports, exports, and structured import processes.
Configure and validate Salesforce security models, including users, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings, and object/field-level access.
Troubleshoot technical issues during implementation, identify root causes, and clearly communicate resolution options.
Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define technical gaps, product issues, enhancement requests, or required development support.
Participate in QA, UAT support, and go-live readiness activities to ensure implementations are accurate, stable, and customer-ready.
Create and maintain technical documentation, including configuration notes, solution designs, deployment notes, testing instructions, and customer-specific implementation details.
Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customers, Implementation Managers, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.
Apply Salesforce and Verifiable implementation best practices to ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with long-term customer success.
qualifications: 3+ years of experience implementing and configuring Salesforce or Salesforce-based SaaS solutions for customers.
Strong hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, including objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and permissions.
Experience building and troubleshooting Salesforce Flows.
Understanding of Salesforce security and sharing architecture, including users, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and object/field-level security.
Experience with data migration, data repair, or data backfill activities using tools such as Data Loader, Salesforce reports, exports, and structured data imports.
Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical implementation tasks.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, especially within Salesforce automation, data, permissions, and configuration.
Ability to identify when a request requires product, engineering, or development support and clearly specify the needed technical changes.

Experience delivering custom Salesforce configuration in environments that include a managed package, with an understanding of package constraints, extension patterns, upgrade impacts, and how to avoid breaking managed package functionality.
